tasks.label: 2. Sandbox: Run Evaluation & Collect Results
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Name 'WindowsSandboxClient','WindowsSandbox' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}/sandbox/eval-build.wsb'; Write-Host '[*] Waiting for Windows Sandbox evaluation...'; $timeout = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(3); while (!(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/test-results/eval.done')) { if ((Get-Date) -gt $timeout) { Stop-Process -Name 'WindowsSandboxClient','WindowsSandbox' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Sandbox evaluation timed out.' }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; Get-Content '${workspaceFolder}/test-results/eval-run.log'; $code = [int](Get-Content '${workspaceFolder}/test-results/eval.done' -Raw).Trim(); Stop-Process -Name 'WindowsSandboxClient','WindowsSandbox' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code
